items.html: And the matter of the taking of this side of Gevura by the Nukva is what is called in the language of the Zohar the embrace of the left; for by this her judgments are sweetened, as mentioned. In that during the time of the deep sleep, the matter of the embrace of the left comes, and then her judgments are mitigated, and then is the sawing. And these three aspects are done together: for by the deep sleep the female has no suckling from the male, and then they separate from their backs and are sawed; and then the side of Gevura and the Bina of ZA enter into her in the aspect of mochin; and this is the embrace of the left. Understand all this well.
